payload.body: JUST IN - U.S. DOJ announces a 15-city nationwide antisemitism "Awareness & Action Tour," to increase reporting of antisemitism, strengthen collaboration between local, and federal, law enforcement and Jewish communities, and foster broad interfaith opposition to antisemitism among Jews, Baptist Christians, Catholics, and Muslims. Source: https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/federal-task-force-combat-anti-semitism-announces-15-city-national-awareness-action-tour @disclosetv
